10.answer:
Dear Milembe,
I hope you are well. Our brother Masanja will graduate in Language Teaching at the University of Dar es Salaam next month. Our family plans to attend and celebrate his achievement. Please join us. I will send the confirmed date and arrangements when I receive them.
Your brother,
Kulwa
10.explanation: Use an informal letter with an address, date, greeting, clear news and family invitation, suitable closing and the requested signature. Avoid inventing an exact ceremony date as a fact.
